test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, symbol series and answer the question.

D & C N ^ E G ^ Y T % @ G R I & * H K & Z $ P * ^

How many consonants are there that are immediately preceded by a consonant and immediately followed by symbol?
solution:
letters that are immediately preceded by a letter and immediately followed by a symbol are shown as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73c50d538c0b881b95ee39ff48523d3b972adf76b3b3db734840844ba235d4b2.png] 

Thus, there are five such pairs:

 
• C N ^
 
• Y T %
 
• H K &
 
• EG ^
 
• RI&

But we have to find **Consonants - Consonants - Symbol**

 
• C N ^
 
• Y T %
 
• H K &

Hence, the correct answer is **Option (4).**
